verdict.rationale: Cooley's own emerging companies page directly documents IPO experience for VC-backed companies, ranking it #1 for taking them public over 20 years, and its S-1 drafting tooling supports the public-offering side. M&A exit experience appears only indirectly, through privacy due-diligence reviews done for M&A transactions, with no dedicated M&A practice page or deal-volume evidence. Missing for 10: a dedicated M&A/exit practice page with deal experience for venture-backed companies, and independent corroboration of the exit track record.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: #1 law firm representing VC-backed companies going public for the last 20 years (IPO Vital Signs, 2025)
Complete an initial, bespoke S-1 draft in minutes rather than days, accelerating the path to substantive legal work
400+ privacy and cybersecurity due diligence reviews conducted in the past year alone for M&A and investment transactions
